job.title: Head of Department, Health and Community Care Programs
job.description:
Melbourne City Institute of Education is an established premium vocational education and training provider located in the heart of Melbourne CBD. The institute is proud of the quality, range of courses, training services and pathways it offers in the Vocational Education and Training sector. 

MCIE is currently seeking an experienced Head of Department to oversee the delivery, management and operations of its health, aged care and disability support qualifications. 

The Head of Department, Health and Community Care will actively contribute to achieving the institute's strategic objectives in partnership with internal and external stakeholders. 

To be considered for this role, you will have: 

  • Hold a TAE40122 Certificate IV in Training and Assessment, an equivalent or higher qualification 
  • significant experience at a level on operational level in the coordination or management of health, aged and disability care qualifications 
  • demonstrated successful experience in supporting the submission of funding applications for health, aged and disability care qualifications 
  • demonstrated commitment to deliver quality vocational training and education programs 
  • comprehensive understanding of the Community Services and Health training packages, the 2025 Standards for Training Organisations, Education Services for Overseas Students (knowledge of VETDSS and the Skills First contract would be helpful) 
  • excellent communication and interpersonal skills 
  • ability to manage a small team 
  • ability to contribute to ongoing review and continuous improvement of vocational education and training programs 
  • ability to comply with reporting requirements and to maintain records in accordance with policies and procedures 

Responsibilities include: 

  • establishing industry links 
  • providing leadership to support the delivery of quality courses 
  • managing the health, aged and disability care course requirements and expectations of each student, work placement host employers and employers 
  • monitoring and supporting student progress 
  • establishing new and maintaining existing industry links 
  • ensuring compliance with all standards, contracts and internal requirements for program delivery 
  • dissemination of relevant information to employers, students and industry 
  • maintaining personal professional development as it relates to the role 
  • supporting the marketing of the department and courses 

Department Scope of Registration: 

The Head of Department, Health and Community Care is responsible for the delivery of the following qualifications: 

  • CHC24015 Certificate II in Active Volunteering 
  • CHC32015 Certificate III in Community Services 
  • CHC33021 Certificate III in Individual Support 
  • CHC43015 Certificate IV in Ageing Support 
  • CHC43121 Certificate IV in Disability Support 
  • CHC43315 Certificate IV in Mental Health 
  • CHC52021 Diploma of Community Services 
  • CHC53315 Diploma of Mental Health 
  • HLT33021 Certificate III in Allied Health Assistance 
  • HLT33115 Certificate III in Health Services Assistance 

 

If this opportunity reflects your skills and experience, we would like to hear from you. Excellent remuneration will be negotiated with the successful candidate. 

Please note: Successful candidates must provide a current Working with Vulnerable People Check or Working with Children Check and NDIS check. 

Start October 2025 or before as negotiated. 

Employer questions 

Your application will include the following questions: 

  • Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia? 
  • Do you have experience working for a registered training organisation (RTO)?

job.title: Upskill your knowledge in Animal Care with Certificate IV in Veterinary Nursing
job.description:
Advance Your Career in Animal Care!

Certificate IV in Veterinary Nursing (ACM40418)

Are you passionate about animal health and ready to turn that passion into a career? The Certificate IV in Veterinary Nursing is a nationally accredited qualification designed to prepare you for a dynamic and rewarding role in veterinary clinics, hospitals, and animal care facilities.

Why Study With Us?

Gain hands-on experience in:

  • Animal nursing care
  • Assisting in surgery and medical procedures
  • Client education on pet health and wellbeing
  • Pathology, imaging, dental and anaesthesia procedures

Entry Requirements

✔ Must be 18 years or older

✔ Able to lift and move animals up to 10kg

✔ Sound English, literacy and numeracy skills (min. Year 10 English or equivalent)

✔ Hold a Certificate II or III in Animal Studies or equivalent experience

International Students Welcome!

Meet English language proficiency (IELTS 6.0 or equivalent) and hold a valid Student Visa.

What You’ll Learn

Complete 17 core and 4 elective units, including:

  • Anatomy, infection control, surgical and medical nursing
  • Pathology, anaesthesia, dental procedures, and more
  • Office procedures and client communication

Where It Can Take You

Graduate job-ready for exciting roles such as:

  • Veterinary Nurse
  • Wildlife or Specialist Veterinary Assistant
  • Animal Health Educator

Enrol Now and begin your journey toward a fulfilling career in veterinary nursing!

Because every animal deserves a skilled and caring nurse—will that be you?

job.title: RTO Compliance Manager - MCIE
job.description:
Compliance Manager

Location Level 9, 250 Collins Street, Melbourne, VIC 3000

Travel Required As required

Reports to Managing Director

Liaises With 

  • Heads of Department Supervises L&D Support Officer
  • Student Administration Manager
  • Marketing & Brand Manager
  • Coordinator, Apprenticeships & Traineeships
  • Finance Manager
  • Director Quality & Governance

MCIE VISION The leading education provider of choice, enabling real life-changing opportunities, empowering our people to think and actively contribute to the global community.

MCIE MISSION LEARN. ACHIEVE. SUCCEED.

To deliver outstanding education and excellent customer service in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment, leading to empowered graduates with real job outcomes.

Position function

The Compliance Manager is responsible for ensuring Melbourne City Institute of Education (MCIE) maintains compliance with the VET Quality Framework, National Code 2018, and all funding contracts active with MCIE at any point in time. The activity of the Compliance Manager underpins the delivery of quality training and assessment practice and the data provision of the organisation.

An individual holding this position is responsible for:

  • ensuring MCIE has in place the policies, procedures, documents, forms, and systems required to ensure compliant implementation of the Standards for RTOs, ESOS Standards, Skills First funding contract including the Skills First Quality Charter and all other relevant legislation.
  • MCIE’s training.gov.au and CRICOS scopes of registration
  • ensuring MCIE delivers training to both the domestic and international student markets. The qualifications, accredited courses, skill sets, and units of competence MCIE is approved to deliver varies from time to time.

Key responsibilities

ENSURING COMPLIANCE AND THE DELIVERY OF QUALITY TRAINING AND ASSESSMENT PRACTICES WITH A STUDENT FOCUS.

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the VET sector and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor MCIE's compliance with the VET Quality Framework, ESOS National Code, VETDSS, and government-funded programs.
  • Communicate and implement any changes to regulatory requirements with other staff members.
  • Plan, schedule, and either conduct or oversee:
  • internal audits – VQF/ESOS/VETDSS/ government-funded programs ie (SVTS) course reviews; and assessment validation
  • Manage and participate in ASQA Performance Assessments and/or state funding department audits.
  • Manage MCIE’s scope of registration including:
  • reviewing scope regularly and communicating changes within the organisation
  • the submission of change and extension of scope applications in conjunction with the Director
  • Manage MCIE’s registration on ASQAnet (change of details and registration renewal applications).
  • In consultation with relevant staff, develop, review and maintain compliance policies and procedures.
  • When required, work with the Manager of Student Administration and the Director of Quality and Governance to ensure mandatory reporting deadlines are maintained and that reports are completed, lodged, and filed.
  • Have the capability to identify, analyse and improve MCIE’s existing training products, services, and processes to improve quality to better meet training and customer needs with a strong focus on monitoring and risk management.
